row_guide: Top: dirt/grass path autotiles, pebbles, stones, bushes implied via flora, flower pots/groups, mushrooms, sprouts, clovers. Upper-mid: grey/brown/black stone crosses, small tombstones, marble markers, long tombstones, stone gates/arches (plain + red-orb) in big/high/medium/small sizes. Mid: open dirt ditches/graves, wood plank vertical graves, dirt piles with/without shovel or cross, candles and holders. Mid-lower: Grace Chapel mausoleums (open + gated), grave cage, leafless dead trees (bare + pumpkin-faced with hanging lanterns), trunk face module. Bottom: squared stone sarcophagi (closed/open/lids/skeleton/skull/ribcage variants), fancy red/silver/yellow coffins, bones/skeleton/skull, crows (4 poses), jack-o'-lanterns in many sizes/colors including hanging branch pumpkins.
